news.title: Health Community: After the Rate Is Set: An Operations and Claims Perspective for Health Actuaries
news.summary: Host Ankit Nanda, FSA, MAAA, FCA, speaks with Eric Berg, Chief Operating Officer at HM Insurance Group, about what happens to a policy after the rate is set. Drawing on a career spanning legal practice, reinsurance claims, and carrier operations, the conversation ranges across site of care and method of delivery, pharmacy, cost volatility, balance billing, COVID's operational aftermath, and the blind spots actuaries
